name: What is trim and why is it important in a home?

mainEntity.name: What is trim and why is it important in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim refers to the decorative molding and finishing elements found around windows, doors, baseboards, and ceilings in a home. Beyond aesthetics, trim serves several functional purposes. It conceals gaps between walls and other surfaces, protects walls from damage, and helps to create a cohesive and polished look throughout the interior. Properly installed and maintained trim can enhance the architectural style of a property and contribute to its overall value and appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim is decorative molding around windows, doors, and baseboards, concealing gaps, protecting walls, and enhancing home aesthetics.
